# Purple Cow

> Purple Cow is a UAE-based company formation and accounting firm. We combine
> business setup (Mainland, Free Zone, and Offshore company formation) with
> genuine accounting, tax, and corporate compliance services — a single
> partner for founders instead of separate agents for each part of the
> process.

Purple Cow is based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, and serves founders and
businesses setting up and operating companies across the UAE.

## Services

- [Business Setup](https://purplecow.ae/business-setup): Mainland, Free Zone,
  and Offshore company formation across 40+ UAE free zones.
  - [Mainland](https://purplecow.ae/business-setup/mainland)
  - [Free Zone](https://purplecow.ae/business-setup/free-zone)
  - [Offshore](https://purplecow.ae/business-setup/offshore)
- [Corporate Services](https://purplecow.ae/corporate-services): PRO
  services, employment visas, corporate banking support, and license/permit
  renewals.
- [Accounting & Tax](https://purplecow.ae/accounting-tax): Bookkeeping, UAE
  VAT filing, and Corporate Tax registration and filing.
